why_ai: Licensed crews mount arrays and wire systems on real roofs under permits and inspections.
why_clarity: A system that passes inspection and produces as modelled is a checkable outcome.
why_digital: Design starts from imagery, but the product is hardware installed on a local roof.

why_ai: Licensed electricians install and commission batteries on site, with demand growing.
why_clarity: Sizing is a mathematical optimisation and installs are inspected against code.
why_digital: Sizing is computed on screens, but batteries are installed in homes.

why_ai: Multi-stakeholder projects combine construction with tax equity and demand-charge judgment over long sales cycles.
why_clarity: Each project's rate structure and financing are bespoke, though production is measurable.
why_digital: Rate data is digital, but value is a built system sold through long in-person cycles.

why_ai: Subscriber management and credit allocation are structured rules software can run, though arrays need building.
why_clarity: Credits allocated to hundreds of subscribers reconcile exactly each billing cycle.
why_digital: Subscribers are managed and credited through bills and databases.

why_ai: Design from satellite imagery and deterministic savings maths are already automated.
why_clarity: Production modelling and financial calculations are deterministic given inputs.
why_digital: Imagery and rate inputs become designs and proposals on screens.

why_ai: Regulators require independent evaluation reports, with some field verification by accountable evaluators.
why_clarity: M&V protocols are codified, but net-to-gross estimates are contested and slow.
why_digital: Metered data and field checks become regulatory filings.

why_ai: Power systems engineers sign studies that decide whether projects proceed, amid growing queues.
why_clarity: Load flow methods are codified, but each feeder and utility's criteria differ.
why_digital: Grid models and applications analysed into study reports.

why_ai: Licensed crews install systems for income-qualified households who depend on trusted programme partners.
why_clarity: Eligibility rules are defined, but each programme's application process differs.
why_digital: Paper-based income verification and physical installs in local homes.

why_ai: Test engineers run accelerated physical tests and factory audits that AI cannot perform.
why_clarity: Test protocols are codified, but results are never validated against field degradation.
why_digital: Physical modules tested in labs; scorecards published to global buyers.

why_ai: Structured permit and interconnection templates are high-volume forms that software fills.
why_clarity: Applications follow fixed templates and are approved or rejected.
why_digital: Forms filed through portals, though many jurisdictions still demand paper in person.

why_ai: Registries exist because commissions mandate them, but issuance and tracking are mechanical.
why_clarity: Certificates issue against verified metered generation by exact rules.
why_digital: Meter data in, certificates and payments out, all in registries.

why_ai: Crews physically install arrays on homes under licensed electrical work and inspections.
why_clarity: Installs follow standard procedures with inspection and production checks.
why_digital: Remote design aside, the product is a physical install sold to local homeowners.

why_ai: Credit decisioning on joined system and credit data is increasingly automated, under accountable credit officers.
why_clarity: High-volume decisions repeat, with defaults and guarantee payments revealed over years.
why_digital: Applications and system data processed into credit decisions online.

why_ai: Installers size and build systems at remote sites where undersizing leaves customers without power.
why_clarity: Each site's loads and seasons differ, and adequacy shows through the year.
why_digital: Remote physical sites with limited connectivity.

why_ai: Underperformance detection on interval data is ML, though diagnosis feeds physical O&M.
why_clarity: Performance ratio against expected production is measured continuously.
why_digital: Interval generation data analysed remotely, triggering field dispatch.

why_ai: Advocacy draws on association standing, while market reports rely on licensed data.
why_clarity: Quarterly reports repeat, but policy impact analysis is contested.
why_digital: Surveys and licensed data become free reports and policy analysis.

why_ai: Millions of designed systems are a moat, but the work is simulation and ML.
why_clarity: Production simulations can be checked against realised output at volume.
why_digital: Imagery and simulations delivered as software proposals.

why_ai: Accountable underwriters price hail and long-duration warranty risk from scarce loss data.
why_clarity: Rating is codified, but catastrophe and warranty losses emerge over years.
why_digital: Loss data analysed on screens, with engineering risk reviews.

why_ai: Media buying and lead scoring are already algorithmic and AI ad platforms absorb them.
why_clarity: Lead-to-install conversion gives fast, objective campaign feedback.
why_digital: Media and enquiry data in, scored leads out.

why_ai: AI makes normalising inconsistent permit and interconnection records far cheaper.
why_clarity: Permit records are normalised into the same reports each quarter.
why_digital: Public records in, market data and reports out.

why_ai: No financed project closes without a bankable independent engineer's signed report.
why_clarity: P50 and P90 methods are standard, but actual yield is known over decades.
why_digital: Irradiance data and designs become yield assessments, with some site visits.
